claim: The European Museum Schengen is open daily 10:00–18:00 in 2026, with the Tourist Info closed on 1 November and the museum closing at 15:00 on 27 April 2026.
quote: The museum is open daily from 10:00 to 18:00. The Tourist Info at the museum will be closed on November 1, 2026. The Schengen Museum will be closed from 3 p.m. on 27 April 2026.

claim: Admission to the Schengen Museum and the boat costs €5 for adults, €3 for ages 7–17, free under 6, with free entry for LuxembourgPass and ICOM holders.
quote: Admission for the museum and the boat costs €5, visitors aged 7 to 17 years pay €3, children up to 6 years old get free admission, holders of Kulturpass pay €1.50, and LuxembourgPass and ICOM holders receive free admission.

claim: The MS Princesse Marie-Astrid where the 1985 Schengen Agreement was signed returned to Schengen in 2025 as Prinzessin Marie-Astrid Europa, officially inaugurated 14 June 2025.
quote: Moored in Schengen on 14th June 1985, the MS Princesse Marie-Astrid went down in history as the place where the free movement of people and the gradual removal of internal borders in Europe took shape.

claim: The Schengen Agreement monument erected in 1997 features three steel columns with stars representing the first signatory countries, near the Princesse Marie-Astrid mooring.
quote: Erected in 1997, the monument features three tall steel columns, each bearing a star to represent the first signatory countries of the Schengen Agreement.

claim: Remich operates Moselle river-cruise boats departing from its promenade, the centrepiece of the Luxembourg Moselle wine region.
Caves St-Martin in Remich, founded in 1919, offers cellar tours through underground galleries explaining sparkling-wine production.
quote: In 1919, in the aftermath of World War I, they set up the Caves St. Martin. You'll discover the secrets to wine-making while strolling through the underground passages that seem to go on for miles.

claim: Mondorf Domaine Thermal's spa is open Mon–Fri 10:00–20:00, Sat 09:00–20:00 and Sun/holidays 09:00–18:00, with hotel access changing from 20 March 2026.
quote: Spa Facility: Monday to Friday from 10am to 8pm; Saturday from 9am to 8pm; Sunday and public holidays from 9am to 6pm. IMPORTANT Hotel access and parking arrangements will change from 20 March 2026.

claim: Museum A Possen in Bech-Kleinmacher combines a 1617-era winemaker's house with folklore, wine and antique-toy collections across 1,200 m² and seven connected houses.
quote: The museum spans 1,200 square meters and features a complete winemaker's house, the history of wine production, and workshops for shoemaking, coopering, and weaving.

claim: Domaines Vinsmoselle offers ~1-hour cellar tours year-round by appointment (except harvest), including the Art Deco Poll-Fabaire crémant cellar at Wormeldange with tastings of six whites, one red and one crémant.
quote: Cellar tours are offered all year by appointment except during the harvest period (around September). The tour duration is around 1 hour.

claim: Since 1 March 2020 all buses, trams and 2nd-class trains in Luxembourg are free for residents and tourists nationwide.
quote: Since March 1, 2020, public transport in Luxembourg, including all buses, trams, and trains within the country, has been entirely free for everyone, regardless of whether you are a resident or a tourist.

claim: Luxembourg City lies about 32 km by road from Perl, roughly a 25-minute drive — at the edge of a 30 km radius.
quote: 32 Km - Distance from luxembourg city to Perl

claim: Luxembourg City's Bock Casemates form a 23-km UNESCO-listed underground tunnel network carved into the cliff by Sigfried's 963 castle and 18th-century Austrian fortifications.
quote: The Bock Casemates are part of an underground system of galleries and tunnels stretching over 23 km, built into the rock for defensive purposes.

claim: Schengen lies directly opposite Perl across the Moselle, roughly 1 mile (a 3-minute bus ride) away.
quote: The distance between Perl and Schengen is 1 mile. The fastest way to get from Perl to Schengen by bus takes 3 minutes.
